description: This PHP source file defines the Controller class within the SuiteCRM module, responsible for managing Elasticsearch settings, including displaying configurations, testing connections, and scheduling full or partial reindexing jobs. It also handles external dependencies such as Elasticsearch client classes and CRM scheduling components.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: A controller class handling Elasticsearch configuration UI actions such as display, save, test connection, and scheduling index jobs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with a view instance.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the Elasticsearch configuration page with scheduler information.

methods.name: doSaveConfig
methods.description: Saves Elasticsearch settings based on POST data.

methods.name: doTestConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to Elasticsearch with provided host credentials and returns success or error details.

methods.name: doFullIndex
methods.description: Schedules a full Elasticsearch reindexing job.

methods.name: doPartialIndex
methods.description: Schedules a partial Elasticsearch reindexing job.

methods.name: scheduleIndex
methods.description: Creates and submits a scheduler job for reindexing, either full or partial.
